description: Exports data from hybrid elements to csv file. This command controls if and what values are included in the exported file. The values being exported by default are positions, forces, groups, and displacements.

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: Includes the position of structure elements

keywords.name: displacement
keywords.description: Includes the displacement vector at the centroid f structure elements

keywords.name: velocity
keywords.description: Includes the velocity vector at the centroid f structure elements

keywords.name: acceleration
keywords.description: Includes the acceleration vector at the centroid f structure elements

keywords.name: force
keywords.description: Includes the forces and the moments at the centroid of structure elements

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Includes the group assignments to elements in the slot defined by keyword Slot

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Specifies the slot s in which the group name is exported. If not specified, slot Default is used.

notes: New in 9.8. Without filename the data goes to out.csv in the working directory.
3D only: FLAC2D has no structure hybrid.
